name: Skills Lab lists seeded skills, opens one, and reaches the agent it is attached to
description: Walks the read-only half of L02 end to end on seeded data: the Skills Lab landing grid (GET /skills, the only screen carrying the per-skill usage aggregates), the rail that replaces it once a skill is open, a skill's Preview tab (?tab= routing, and the body rendered as markdown rather than as source), its Versions tab (the skill_versions read path), then a second skill's Stats tab and the 'Open' link that lands on the agent editor's Skills tab. That last hop is the point of the flow: agent_skills is invisible everywhere else in the UI, and this closes the loop from 'a skill exists' to 'this agent will send it'. api-contract-guard is used for the Stats hop because it is the one seeded skill linked to exactly ONE agent, which keeps the 'Open' locator unambiguous. Tabs are addressed as `role button` because the sidebar nav item is also called 'Skills' and is an anchor — role is what separates them. Deliberately NOT asserted: toggling, saving, importing and drag-reorder are writes that would mutate the shared seeded stack, and 'the disabled skill is hidden' is unexpressible with only positive locators — both live in the client unit tests and server integration tests. Precondition: a freshly seeded DB (npm run e2e:hermetic), which seeds thirteen skills (L02 added three API-contract ones, unlinked) and links api-contract-guard to the API Contract agent. The count in the badge below tracks that total — a new seeded skill moves it.
